events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect worktree state, dev server, and t460 ancestry
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && git status --short | head -20; git log --oneline -3; git branch --show-current; ps -p 43146 -o pid,command | tail -1; git fetch -q origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/agent/t460-v2-on-main HEAD && echo T460_IN || echo T460_MISSING; git log --oneline -1 origin/main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktrees and branch ancestry on origin
events.input: $ git worktree list | head; git merge-base --is-ancestor 90578a13 origin/main && echo T459_ON_MAIN; git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/agent/t460-v2-on-main origin/main && echo T460_ON_MAIN || echo T460_NOT_ON_MAIN; git log --oneline origin/main..origin/agent/t460-v2-on-main | head; git log --oneline 90578a13..origin/main | wc -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create fresh worktree at origin/main and merge v2 branch
events.input: $ git worktree prune && git worktree add -q -b t459-finish /private/tmp/t459m origin/main 2>&1 | tail -2; cd /private/tmp/t459m && git merge --no-edit origin/agent/t460-v2-on-main 2>&1 | tail -5; git status --short | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify merge contents and tooling
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && git log --oneline -2; grep -rn "Refresh your OS context" app/src | head -3; grep -n "start-os-download" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -2; ls app/node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo APP_NM || echo NO_APP_NM; ls cloud/node_modules >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo CLOUD_NM || echo NO_CLOUD_NM; ls app/scripts | grep -E "probe-(guides|day-prompts|day-model|flows)|check-guides"; head -30 cloud/scripts/build.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Install app and cloud dependencies
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent 2>&1 | tail -3) && cd ../cloud && (npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent 2>&1 | tail -3); echo EXIT $?

events.text: The old worktree was cleared, so I rebuilt it from origin/main with the v2 branch merged in. Next I'm running the static probes.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run static probes and inspect probe-guides usage
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && mkdir -p evidence/T-459 && for p in check-guides probe-day-model probe-day-prompts; do node app/scripts/$p.mjs > evidence/T-459/$p.txt 2>&1; echo "$p exit $?"; tail -2 evidence/T-459/$p.txt; done; sed -n 1,25p app/scripts/probe-guides.mjs | grep -iE "usage|BASE|url|port|argv" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start dev server on port 4391 and wait for guides page
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && (npx next dev -p 4391 > /private/tmp/t459m-dev.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:4391/debug/guides 2>/dev/null | grep -q 200 && break; sleep 3; done; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4391/debug/guides; lsof -ti:4391 | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show dev server errors
events.input: $ grep -iE "error|module not found|cannot" /private/tmp/t459m-dev.log | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how scripts supply the Clerk key
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && grep -rln "CLERK_PUBLISHABLE" app/scripts cloud/scripts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rhn "NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=" app/scripts cloud/scripts 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check how the static export handles Clerk
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && grep -rn "clerk" app/scripts/export-static.sh | head -5; grep -rln "ClerkProvider" app/src | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Restart dev server with a placeholder Clerk key
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && for pid in $(pgrep -f "next dev -p 4391"); do kill $pid; done; sleep 2; K="pk_test_$(printf 'example.clerk.accounts.dev$' | base64)"; (NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=$K CLERK_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_dummy npx next dev -p 4391 > /private/tmp/t459m-dev.log 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 60); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:4391/debug/guides); [ "$c" = 200 ] && break; sleep 3; done; echo $c; pgrep -f "next dev -p 4391"

events.text: The dev server is up on :4391. I'm starting probe-guides in the background and running build.sh in parallel.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-guides against the dev server
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && node scripts/probe-guides.mjs http://localhost:4391/debug/guides > ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Build the centre for Cloudflare
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && bash cloud/scripts/build.sh > /private/tmp/t459m-build.log 2>&1; echo "build exit $?"; tail -5 /private/tmp/t459m-build.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check coordination log for holds and probe progress
events.input: $ grep -n -i "publish held\|deploy held\|hold" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5; tail -5 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300; tail -3 /private/tmp/t459m/evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect probe-guides output and selector
events.input: $ head -5 /private/tmp/t459m/evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt; grep -n "guides ·\|data-guide\|querySelectorAll" /private/tmp/t459m/app/scripts/probe-guides.mjs | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check why the guides page renders no guides
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && curl -s http://localhost:4391/debug/guides | grep -o 'data-guide[^ ]*' | head -3; curl -s http://localhost:4391/debug/guides | grep -oiE "<title>[^<]*|not found|error[^<]{0,80}" | head -5; ls src/app/debug/ 2>/dev/null; grep -n "data-guide" src/app/debug/guides/*.tsx 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Debug guide count after hydration in a browser
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && cat > /private/tmp/t459m-dbg.mjs <<'EOF'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for the guides page in the static build
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && ls cloud/public | head -20; ls -d cloud/public/debug/guides* cloud/public/*/debug/guides* 2>/dev/null

events.text: The guides probe passed without checking anything: Clerk's middleware is rejecting the placeholder key, so the page renders 0 guides. I'm checking whether the middleware has a dev bypass.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the Next middleware
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && ls src/middleware.ts src/proxy.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n 1,40p src/middleware.ts src/proxy.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Set middleware aside temporarily and recheck guide count
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && mv src/proxy.ts /private/tmp/t459m-proxy.ts.bak && sleep 4 && node /dev/stdin <<'EOF' 2>&1 | tail -4

events.text: 25 guides render now. Rerunning the real probe-guides.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-guides with guides rendering
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && node scripts/probe-guides.mjs http://localhost:4391/debug/guides > ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?" | tee -a ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt; grep -v "· ok$" ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt | head -20; grep -c "· ok$" ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt

events.text: While that runs: tsc for app and cloud, plus probe-flows.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Typecheck app and cloud, inspect probe-flows usage
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m && (cd app && npx tsc --noEmit -p . > ../evidence/T-459/tsc-app.txt 2>&1; echo "tsc app $?"); (cd cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . > ../evidence/T-459/tsc-cloud.txt 2>&1; echo "tsc cloud $?"); grep -n "Usage\|argv\|static" app/scripts/probe-flows.mjs | head -5; cat evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt | head -12

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-flows static and read the Clerk stub
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && node scripts/probe-flows.mjs > ../evidence/T-459/probe-flows.txt 2>&1; echo "flows static $?"; tail -2 ../evidence/T-459/probe-flows.txt; sed -n 20,30p scripts/export-static.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count non-Clerk probe-guides failures so far
events.input: $ sleep 1; f=/private/tmp/t459m/evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt; grep -c "px ·" $f; grep "✗" $f | grep -vc "ClerkJS"; grep "✗" $f | grep -v ClerkJS | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Swap in the Clerk stub temporarily and recheck page errors
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && for pid in $(pgrep -f "probe-guides.mjs http://localhost:4391"); do kill $pid; done; sed -n 22,29p scripts/export-static.sh | sed '1d;$d' > src/lib/clerk-static-stub.tsx; grep -rl '@clerk/nextjs"' src > /private/tmp/t459m-clerkfiles.txt; cat /private/tmp/t459m-clerkfiles.txt; xargs sed -i '' 's#from "@clerk/nextjs"#from "@/lib/clerk-static-stub"#' < /private/tmp/t459m-clerkfiles.txt; head -3 src/lib/clerk-static-stub.tsx; sleep 5; cp /private/tmp/t459m-dbg.mjs scripts/_dbg.mjs && node scripts/_dbg.mjs; rm scripts/_dbg.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Rerun probe-guides with the Clerk stub
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/app && time node scripts/probe-guides.mjs http://localhost:4391/debug/guides > ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt 2>&1; echo "exit $?" >> ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worker name, migrations and probe progress
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/cloud && grep -E '^name|"name"' wrangler.* | head -2; ls migrations | tail -3; git -C /private/tmp/t459m diff --stat origin/main~9 HEAD -- cloud/migrations | tail -1; sleep 60; cat ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt

events.text: probe-guides is still running with the stub in place. Meanwhile I'm checking whether the remote D1 has any pending migrations.

events.name: Bash
events.head: List unapplied remote D1 migrations
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t459m/cloud && grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.jsonc wrangler.json 2>/dev/null | head -1; DB=$(grep -o '"database_name": *"[^"]*"' wrangler.json* | head -1 | sed 's/.*: *"//;s/"//'); npx wrangler d1 migrations list $DB --remote 2>&1 | tail -4; cat ../evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait and check probe-guides progress
events.input: $ sleep 240; cat /private/tmp/t459m/evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for first probe-guides output
events.input: $ f=/private/tmp/t459m/evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt; until [ -s $f ] || [ $SECONDS -gt 280 ]; do sleep 5; done; cat $f | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for probe-guides to progress
events.input: $ f=/private/tmp/t459m/evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt; until grep -q "^exit" $f || [ $SECONDS -gt 590 ]; do sleep 10; done; cat $f

events.name: Bash
events.head: Keep waiting for probe-guides
events.input: $ f=/private/tmp/t459m/evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt; until grep -q "^exit" $f || [ $SECONDS -gt 590 ]; do sleep 10; done; cat $f

events.name: Bash
events.head: Keep waiting for probe-guides
events.input: $ f=/private/tmp/t459m/evidence/T-459/probe-guides.txt; until grep -q "^exit" $f || [ $SECONDS -gt 590 ]; do sleep 10; done; tail -6 $f
